page.overview:
Who is Ceodore Harvey?

Prince Ceodore Harvey is a playable character and the main protagonist of Final Fantasy IV: The After Years. Son of Cecil Harvey and Rosa Farrell, he is named after his uncle, Cecil's older brother, Theodor. He is one-quarter Lunarian due to his father's half-Lunarian heritage.

Ceodore has short, spiky blond hair (though his sprite has blue hair) and light blue eyes. He wears a blue suit of armor with a red and white scarf around his neck.

When he sets out with Biggs and Wedge to earn his Proof of Knighthood, Ceodore is a young boy who has no confidence in himself, his abilities, or his family bloodlines, despite Wedge's unending faith in him. He considers himself a common soldier and remains so until his fight with the Sand Worm, where Ceodore reveals a brave and determined side due to an urge to be an individual and carve his own path rather than follow in his father's footsteps like everyone expects him to. Ceodore cares deeply for both Biggs and Wedge and, during his and Kain Highwind's battles to save Baron, the dragoon teaches the young man courage, determination, and resolve. Ultimately, through the support of Biggs and Wedge, Ceodore learns to take pride in both himself and his parents while remaining independent. These elements of Ceodore's personality allow him to help Cecil regain his sense of self while fighting the Dark Knight in the True Moon.

Kain tells Cecil that Ceodore has talent and is every bit as earnest as Cecil is, but mentions that his stubborn streak must come from Rosa.
